text.tspan: Always: helper2-web, helper2 and helper2-backoffice Deployments (RollingUpdate maxSurge 1,
maxUnavailable 0, spread by hostname), the migrate Job of the release, postgres and redis
StatefulSets (one replica, RWO volume; postgres: startup probe up to 10 min, then liveness;
redis: liveness after 30 s), ServiceAccount helper2 without token,
new pods ready one at a time
missed if it cannot start within an hour;
rclone crypt, then copy tonight's dump to R2;
